dialogue.content: （おはようございます。本日はどうぞよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Good morning. Thank you for coming in today. I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.content: (お時間で始めていきますね)
dialogue.English: (It's time, so let's get started.)

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: おはようございます。相談員です。まず、ご年齢と性別をお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good morning. I'm your counselor. First, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 53歳，女です
dialogue.English: I'm 53 years old, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなことでおいでくださいましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What brings you in today?

dialogue.content: 生きる気力が湧かないんです
dialogue.English: I just can't find the will to live.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何かおありだったのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Has something happened?

dialogue.content: もしよろしければ無理のない範囲でお話できますか？
dialogue.English: If it’s alright with you, could you share as much as you're comfortable with?

dialogue.content: 最近夫が亡くなりました
dialogue.English: My husband passed away recently.

dialogue.content: ええ、、、それは悲しいですね
dialogue.English: Oh... I'm so sorry to hear that. That must be so sad.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しかも、最近なのですね、、無理もないと思います。
dialogue.English: And it was recent... It's completely understandable that you feel this way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 体調は大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling physically? Are you okay?

dialogue.content: 特には大丈夫だと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'm okay, for the most part.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、、今はどのようなお気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: I see... How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: つらいですかね、
dialogue.English: It's painful, I guess.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。つらいですね。。。家族を見送られた方の多くは喪失感や絶望を感じられると聞きます
dialogue.English: I can imagine... It is painful. I've heard that many people who have lost a family member feel a sense of profound loss and despair.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい、生きる気力がわかなくなる、というのは自然な事でもあると聞きます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I've heard it's quite natural to lose the will to live in such a situation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたは今ご家族と住んでらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you living with your family right now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですか、少し安心しました、どなたとお住まいなのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. I'm a little relieved to hear that. Who do you live with?

dialogue.content: 子供と住んでます
dialogue.English: I live with my child.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、お子さんはおいくつで、お子さんとは何か話されているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How old is your child, and are you able to talk with them?

dialogue.content: 20代ですなにか…いろいろ話してますかね
dialogue.English: They're in their 20s. We... talk about various things, I suppose.

dialogue.content: 普通の会話です
dialogue.English: Just everyday conversations.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。何気ない会話ができているのですね。少し安心しました。
dialogue.English: Thank you. So you're able to have casual conversations. I'm a little relieved to hear that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先ほど生きる力がわかないとおっしゃられましたが、それはどのくらい続いていらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you can't find the will to live. How long have you been feeling that way?

dialogue.content: 夫が亡くなってからですね
dialogue.English: Ever since my husband passed away.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、、パートナーさんが亡くなられてどのくらい経つのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... How long has it been since your partner passed away?

dialogue.content: 3ヶ月くらいです
dialogue.English: It's been about three months.

dialogue.content: ええ、まだほんと最近なのですね
dialogue.English: Oh, it's still very recent, then.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その前はそういう感じはなかったのですか？
dialogue.English: And before that, did you feel differently?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、、、お辛い時期にお話しを聞かせていただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see... Thank you for sharing this with me during such a difficult time.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: 生きる力が湧いてこないお気持ちについてですが、どのように受け止められていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Regarding this feeling of not having the will to live, how are you making sense of it?

dialogue.content: お答えは無理なさらないでくださいね、辛くなってきたら遠慮なくおっしゃってください
dialogue.English: Please don't feel pressured to answer. If it becomes too difficult, please don't hesitate to tell me.

dialogue.content: どのように受け止めてるとはどういうことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by, 'how am I making sense of it'?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、生きる力がわかない事が、ご自分にとってつらい状況だと思うのですが、
dialogue.English: Well... I imagine that not having the will to live is a painful situation for you,

dialogue.content: いまはそのままでいいと感じられているのか、生きる力がもっと湧いてほしいと感じられているの、どちか近い方はありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel it’s okay to stay as you are for now, or do you wish you could feel more of the will to live? Which is closer to how you feel?

dialogue.content: どちらかと言ったら生きる力が今より湧いてほしいですかね…
dialogue.English: If I had to choose, I guess I'd say I want more of a will to live than I have now.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、確かにお辛い時間が長く続くのはとてもつらく長く感じられると思います。
dialogue.English: I see. I imagine when a painful time drags on like this, it must feel very long and difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私も逆の立場だったら何もやる気が起きなくなると思います。一日はどのように過ごされているのですか？
dialogue.English: If I were in your position, I don't think I'd have the energy to do anything either. How do you spend your days?

dialogue.content: 普通の生活は出来ていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Are you able to manage everyday life?

dialogue.content: 普通になんとなく過ごしています
dialogue.English: I'm just sort of getting through the days as usual.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、それだけでも本当に大変なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. I think that in and of itself is a very difficult thing to do.

dialogue.content: 日常はなんとなく生活はできているけどお辛い状況が続いているのですね
dialogue.English: So you're managing to get by day-to-day, but the painful situation continues.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いま、一番つらい時間って何をしている時間ですか？
dialogue.English: What is the most painful time of day for you right now? And what are you doing then?

dialogue.content: 1番つらい時間…
dialogue.English: The most painful time...

dialogue.content: なんだろ、わからないです
dialogue.English: I wonder... I don't know.

dialogue.content: では、一日のうちで少し気分がいいなぁと感じられる時はありますか？
dialogue.English: Then, is there any time during the day when you feel even a little bit better?

dialogue.content: ないですかね、、
dialogue.English: I don't think so...

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、それは一日が辛くて仕方がないですね
dialogue.English: I see. That must make the entire day feel unbearably painful.

dialogue.content: ですかね、
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: 一日で気分が良くなる事がないというのは、とてもつらい状況かと聞いていて感じます。
dialogue.English: Hearing that there isn't any time in the day when you feel better, it sounds like a very painful situation.

dialogue.content: 少し整理をしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: May I try to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんが亡くなり3か月たったが生きる力がわかない。子供さん（20歳）がいるが普通の会話はできている。ただ、日常で気分がいいと感じられる時間は無く、とてもつらい状況が続いている。
dialogue.English: It's been three months since your partner passed away, and you can't find the will to live. You have a child in their 20s, and you are able to have normal conversations. However, you don't have any moments during the day where you feel good, and this very painful situation is ongoing.

dialogue.content: 今日来ていただいたのは少しでも生きる力が湧いてくるようになれればいいと感じられてここに来ていただいた。
dialogue.English: And you came here today with the hope that you might be able to regain even a little of that will to live.

dialogue.content: そんな風に感じたのですが、何かずれていたりしてなさそうですか？
dialogue.English: That's my understanding of it. Does that sound right, or is there anything I've missed or gotten wrong?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫だと思います
dialogue.English: I think that's right.

dialogue.content: 少しでもあなたに生きる力が湧いてこられるように私も応援したいと思っています。
dialogue.English: I want to support you in finding even a little bit of that will to live again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 何か、話足りない事はありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else you feel you haven't had a chance to say?

dialogue.content: たぶんないと思います
dialogue.English: Probably not, I don't think so.

dialogue.content: 今は少しでもお気持ちを癒す時期だと思うのです、そして、その後に少しづつ力が湧いてくるのかなぁと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I think now is a time for healing your feelings, even just a little. And then, after that, perhaps your strength will gradually return. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: ご家族を見送られて、何年も喪失感が続き少しずつ元の生活に戻っていかれる方もいらっしゃると聞きます。
dialogue.English: I've heard that for some people who lose a family member, the sense of loss can continue for years as they gradually return to their former lives.

dialogue.content: お話を聞いていて、いまは、あなたの心を少しずつ癒せる時間が必要なのかなぁととても感じます。
dialogue.English: Listening to you, I feel strongly that what you need right now is time to heal your heart, little by little.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ご自分の心を癒せそうな時間は作れそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you could make some time to heal your heart?

dialogue.content: わからないですけど、考えてみます
dialogue.English: I'm not sure, but I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: どんな事でもいいと思います。朝日を見るとか、お花を一輪買ってくるとか、
dialogue.English: I think it can be anything at all. Like watching the sunrise, or buying a single flower.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 以前楽しかったことも今は楽しく感じられないと思ったりもするかもしれないですが、焦らなくていいと、私は思います。
dialogue.English: You might find that things you used to enjoy don't feel enjoyable right now, but I think there's no need to rush.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 少しずつ、気持ちを癒せる時間を作って差し上げてくださいね。いつかそんな時間が作れると私も信じていますので。
dialogue.English: Please try to create some time to heal your feelings, little by little. I believe that one day, you'll be able to make that time for yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日はとてもつらいお気持ちを話してくださりありがとうございます。つらい事をつらいと言えるようになってきたのも一つの心の歩みだと思いますので、そんな小さな歩みをきちんと感じられてここに来ていただいた事にも敬意を感じました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such painful feelings with me today. Being able to say that something is painful is, I believe, a step forward in itself. I have great respect for the fact that you recognized that small step and decided to come here today.

dialogue.content: また、なにか心に動きがありましたら是非ここに来ていただけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: If there are any changes in how you're feeling, please feel free to come back here.

dialogue.content: わかりましたありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ではご自愛くださいね。またお待ちしておりますので。
dialogue.English: Please take good care of yourself. I'll be here when you're ready to come back.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye for now, then.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （今日はありがとうございました。深いお題でした。評価の方どうぞよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. It was a profound topic. I would appreciate your evaluation.)

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)
